title: Bug Hunt
logline: A tired dev blames the bug. His lead runs the numbers. The bug is the coffee. Or him.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Three coffees. And I still can't find the bug.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Easy. One coffee is focus. Two is speed.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Wait. So the bug... is me?
